subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this dependency batch proceed with the Socket obfuscated-code alerts for `@emnapi/runtime` and `@react-email/ui`, after the formatter output is fixed?
rationale: The formatter fix is mechanical, but accepting or avoiding the flagged dependency packages is a security/supply-chain risk decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Require security acceptance first
options.body: Fix formatting, then merge only after a maintainer/security reviewer explicitly accepts or dismisses the two Socket alerts.

options.title: Split the flagged updates
options.body: Land safe updates separately and move Vite/React Email or their transitive flagged packages into a narrower review.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or let Dependabot regenerate the batch if the combined update is not worth the supply-chain review overhead.
